instruction: A clean studio photograph, full shot at eye-level, captures an indoor ballet studio with a wooden barre. On the left, the red-haired girl in a pink leotard (R3) stands facing forward with a bright smile, her hands resting on her hips. On the right, the dark-haired girl in a pink leotard (R2) stands in a matching pose with hands on her hips, looking slightly to the left. They stand side-by-side in front of the barre under soft, bright studio lighting against a plain white wall.
